summary_1line: On his wedding night the monster murders Elizabeth, Victor’s father soon dies of grief, and Victor vows revenge and begins a futile appeal to authorities.

image_candidates.scene_text: Elizabeth lies lifeless across the bridal bed, her pale face half veiled by hair while stormlight flickers through the dark room.
The monster grins at the open window, moonlight behind him, pointing mockingly at Elizabeth’s corpse before Victor fires his pistol.
Victor collapses beside Elizabeth’s body, clutching her cold limbs while horrified inn guests crowd the doorway.
